description:
A screenshot of the CLC+ Core web application's "Edit Ingestion" page, illustrating the process of ingesting data and mapping input classes to EAGLE elements for publishing.

The left panel displays metadata for a dataset, including:
- **INSPIRE Themes**: "LU Land use" and "LC Land cover".
- **Created By**: "User Admin/Support CLC+ Core".
- **Organisation/s**: European Environment Agency (EEA).
- **Contact Person**: `infoservice@cbs.nl`.
- **Link to Document/s**: Multiple URLs, including `https://geodata.nationaalgeoregister.nl/bestandbodemgebruik2015/wfs?request=GetCapabilities`.
- **Description**: An abstract in Dutch describing "Het Bestand Bodemgebruik 2015", stating it contains digital geometry of land use in the Netherlands, based on Top10NL and aerial photo interpretation from 2015, and mentioning the "Bestand Bodemgebruik 2017" will be published in 2021. Additional information link: `https://www.cbs.nl/-/media/imported/onzendiensten/methoden/classificaties/documents/2009/04/bestandbodemgebruik-productbeschrijving.pdf`.
- **Lineage**: Dutch text stating the use of geometric boundaries from BRT, aerial photos for interpretation, and other municipal information, with a 2-3 year update frequency. It re-states the 2017 dataset publication in 2021.

The right panel features an "Input Classes" table with the following columns:
- **Class Code**: Numeric identifier for input classes.
- **Name***: Name of the input class.
- **EAGLE Elements***: Displays the primary EAGLE element assigned and a count of additional elements (+X), where '+X' means X more EAGLE elements are barcoded for that Input class beyond the first one shown.
- **100% EAGLE compliant**: Indicates compliance status with a green checkmark for compliant or a greyed-out check for non-compliant/pending.
- **Colour**: A coloured square representing the assigned display colour.
- **Show in Map**: A checkbox to toggle visibility on an embedded map.

Visible rows in the Input Classes table include:
- **Class Code 10**: "Railway", mapped to "Conventional Buildings +7", 100% EAGLE compliant, black colour, shown in map.
- **Class Code 11**: "Roads", mapped to "Conventional Buildings +5", not 100% EAGLE compliant (greyed-out check), red colour, not shown in map (indicated by empty checkbox with a chain icon).
- **Class Code 12**: "Airport", mapped to "Conventional Buildings +8", 100% EAGLE compliant, grey colour, shown in map.
- **Class Code 20**: "Residential al[unreadable]", mapped to "Sealed Artificial Surfaces +13", 100% EAGLE compliant, yellow colour, shown in map.
- **Class Code 21**: "Retail trade, f[unreadable]", mapped to "Sealed Artificial Surfaces +5", 100% EAGLE compliant, pink colour, shown in map.
- **Class Code 22**: "Public faciliti[unreadable]", mapped to "Sealed Artificial Surfaces +9", 100% EAGLE compliant, yellow colour, shown in map.
- **Class Code 23**: "Socio-cultura[unreadable]", mapped to "Sealed Artificial Surfaces +7", 100% EAGLE compliant, orange colour, shown in map.
- **Class Code 24**: "Business par[unreadable]", mapped to "Sealed Artificial Surfaces +9", 100% EAGLE compliant, grey colour, shown in map.

A small map snippet in the top right shows a geographic area including parts of Belgium and Germany, with the city of Lille visible. The map includes a scale bar indicating "50 km" and "50 mi". Map attribution states "Leaflet | EEA Copernicus programme, German Aerospace Center (DLR) | CC-BY 3.0". The system date and time displayed at the bottom right is "01.04.2022 16:26".
